verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation provides generic building blocks—up-to-date runtimes/packages via a single command, container tooling from the Red Hat ecosystem, and Boxes for spinning up VMs—but there's no evidence of curated, ready-made environment templates for specific frameworks/languages (e.g., one-click Node/Python/Java dev stacks or devcontainer-style presets). Community evidence is generic distro sentiment, not about dev environment setup specifically. Missing for 10: language/framework-specific preconfigured environment templates, first-party dev-container or toolbx presets, and independent hands-on evidence of quick framework setup.
